summary: SiliconFlow's API pricing page marks selected models free for input and output. Currently free: tencent/Hunyuan-MT-7B and PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 (chat), BAAI bge-m3 / bge-reranker-v2-m3 / bge-large-zh-v1.5 / bge-large-en-v1.5 (embeddings), Kwai-Kolors/Kolors (image), and XingChenAGI XingChenGSR-V1.0 / XingChenASR V3.2 / V3.2-Ultra / ASR-Diarize-V3.0, Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B and FunAudioLLM/SenseVoiceSmall (speech). GLM-Z1-9B-0414 was removed from the free tier and is now paid ($0.086/M tokens).
claim_steps: Choose a model marked 免费/free in the API pricing catalog.
Use the selected model through SiliconFlow's API.

social_proof.title: SiliconFlow API Pricing
social_proof.text: tencent/Hunyuan-MT-7B and PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 are listed with 免费 input/output prices; BAAI bge-* embeddings, Kwai-Kolors/Kolors, and XingChen/Qwen3-ASR/SenseVoiceSmall speech models are marked 免费.
